meta.title: Dana Point Market, March 2026: Spring Opens Earlier Than Last Year | Adam Boehrer, Pacific Sotheby's
meta.headline: Spring is opening with a different tone than last year.
meta.lede: February closed faster than I expected and the spring buyer pool is forming earlier. This issue looks at Dana Point, where Del Prado Place adds 18 condos to the Lantern District and Harbor Phase 3 demolition is now underway.
meta.description: The 2026 spring buyer pool formed earlier than last year across South Orange County. This issue covers Dana Point: 18 new Del Prado Place condos in the Lantern District, Harbor Phase 3 demolition, and the Festival of Whales. By Adam Boehrer, Pacific Sotheby's International Realty.
meta.og_title: Dana Point Market, March 2026: Spring Opens on a Different Tone
meta.og_description: February closed faster than expected and the spring buyer pool formed early. Plus Del Prado Place, Harbor Phase 3 demolition, and Doheny in the locals' window.

parts.html: The February closing figures that ran in the emailed edition of this issue are not reproduced here. For current San Clemente numbers, updated every two weeks from CRMLS, see the San Clemente housing market report.
